path_identity.UN_midrange: R1 VP_UN / R5 UN_midrange with original .5 readout
path_identity.UN_final475: frozen R4/R5 tau=.475 with rho>.9 unchanged T fallback
path_identity.raw_UN: R1 independent c field and reliability graph, without VP additions; not R6 raw-query graph
path_identity.T: R1 original saved independent c readout
path_identity.INS_endpoints: same released INSID3 full path; bilinear and official CRF640 separately, not independent votes

definitions.missing_path_policy: R5 has no saved complete raw_UN/T natural-mask cohort; do not generate it from fields. Joint common failures always name the available path set.
definitions.ordered_overlap: For first path A and second C, both_share means both change FoRIS; second_vetoes_first means only A changes FoRIS; second_only means only C changes FoRIS. Report four edit labels for each subset. These are masks already produced, not an executed composite.
definitions.complementarity: On FoRIS errors, at least one other saved path correct versus all saved paths wrong; per-path unique correct and unique harmful changes reported separately.
definitions.metric: CLI1024, original per-case valid/ignore masks; class scores pool I/U per observed (fold,class) then equal slots

limits: Pixel- or episode-oracle selection is not an inference rule; none is deployed here.
INSID3 endpoints share one inference path and UN endpoints share one field; do not count them as independent evidence.
R5 raw_UN/T masks are absent; no such outputs were generated or silently substituted.
Ordered edit support is a structural diagnostic; a new natural composite must be explicitly implemented and evaluated before claiming its performance.
Edit-budget counts are pixel pooled, whereas class IoU weights slots; budget ratios alone do not rank final composites.
The six illustrative cases are selected post hoc by an explicit count criterion. Do not use them as representative success claims.
